items.claim: D-Rod hasn't fought in over a year.
items.quote: He hasn't fought in over a year.

items.claim: Medic has fought three times since D-Rod's last fight.
items.quote: Medic since the last time that D-Rod has fought, Medic has fought three times, he's been super active

items.claim: D-Rod had to get in shape at the start of his camp rather than coming in already prepared.
items.quote: D-Rod had to get in shape at the start of his camp.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is 15 years younger than Jan Blachowicz.
items.quote: This makes Navajo Sterling 15 years younger than the former champion Yan Blahovich.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is two inches taller and holds a one-inch reach advantage.
items.quote: He's also two inches taller at 6'4 and he's got a 1 inch reach advantage at 79 inches of reach.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has the advantage of extensive experience against top competition as a former champion.
items.quote: you absolutely have to favor the experience for Yan Blahovich. I mean, this guy's the former champion. He's been in there with the best of the best.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling plays it super safe and doesn't take unnecessary risks in his fights.
items.quote: he's kind of also not taking any unnecessary risks. He's playing it super safe in these fights.
